lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. The decision asked of Brandon in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday stands unanswered: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first. The work goes on in either case and only the freeze waits.

The fourteenth publish (main with chain 42, spring's glass after a shake) is built here: type check exit 0, the whole test run 1060 passed and 9 skipped (the ninth skip is the test of the built page, which skips in the publish's own tree, as at the thirteenth), build exit 0, engine dc59c0d7c2daa6ab. Running now: the build without sound files for the security review, the poster check and the review page. Then the security review and the publish. The live check on a helper machine passed on its own build of the same commit (stated by the helper, its pictures looked at here): thirteen loads went live with 0 console messages and 33 buttons each, the plain address after 13 s, low quality after 8 to 9 s, medium after 10 to 12 s; four real shakes landed on the right season (30.1 s at low, 43.5 s at medium, 33.1 s and 35.7 s at the plain address); spring's glass shows drops and runs after the landing at all three qualities. Seen there at full size: the lower ends of the runs have square corners in a few places. The first pictures were compared here with the thirteenth's: the 60 pictures are the same bytes and only their record differs, as expected, since chain 42 moved spring after a shake alone. The thirteenth publish stays live until every check passes.

The petals' weave (item 278). Decision 258: the last mend is taken for the merge as a gain, not as a pass. Measured by its builder on the 4K frames at the masters' tier: at film frame 1388's rib the measure fell from 1.656 to 0.872, where the floor asked for 0.828, so the floor is logged as not met there by its number; at frame 1389 it fell from 1.439 to 0.605, met. Seen here at full 4K size: no rib and no crossed weave at 1388 and 1389 with the mend, and at frame 2121 main carries upright ribs in one patch where the mend has none. A dotted edge at one dark gap stands in both. Film frames 668 and 2108 are the same bytes with and without the mend (verified here). The item stays open as a fine grain, about a fifth more where the ribs stood. Before it reaches main, two more pairs are being drawn at 4K at the masters' tier on four helper machines: the petals arriving (film frames 681 and 682) and fall's leaves leaving (2828 and 2829), each on main and with the mend. The first of the eight is in (frame 682 with the mend, 58 samples), the rest are due between about 7:57 PM and 8:15 PM MT (the helpers' guesses). Correction to Status 241: its six control frames are six pictures of four film frames.

Chain 42's extra looks are in and were looked at here: twelve pictures of the four seasons, spring's glass at 4K at film frames 780 and 781 (drops and runs stand at the same places in both frames, edges soft and whole, no beads and no crawl seen, not played), and thirteen frames from 696 to 744 at preview size (nothing torn, no bare glass).

The stall at low quality on a software renderer. Decision 257. Measured by its builder over 16 named presses each: on the points' head with the mend no second stand (9 of 16 before); on main with the mend 1 of 16 (1622 ms, begun 7770 ms after its press, cause not found; 2 of 16 before). Its plan is taken: two more walks with time stamps on the merged tree. Reports due about 8:50 PM and 9:30 PM MT.

Summer's fireflies (item 276): a helper drew film frames 1435, 1440 and 1470 at 4K on main for the builder's measures. Its first report is due by 9:00 PM MT. The frost line at film frame 668 (item 275): report due about 9:20 PM MT. The final render on his own computer: the builder's ready commit is pushed (the send back step and its test, a mend for a file held by another program on Windows, both Windows 4K jobs through Direct3D 11) and its whole proof runs on hosted Windows and macOS machines now; measured by it on the run before: the Git Bash flow on Windows passed whole in 21 minutes. No final render is started in the cloud.

A fault seen and gone: for about four minutes after a session's resume, the machine here and that builder's machine could not sign in to GitHub (three pushes of its commit failed here between 7:51 and 7:53 PM MT, nothing was pushed from here). Its sign in came back by itself and it pushed its commit itself. Cause unknown. No sign in was looked for or changed.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. The fourteenth publish at the same address: spring's glass after a shake. Chain 43: the petals' weave. Chain 44: the stall's mend, the frost line, summer's fireflies and the seeds' dots, the Direct3D mend, as each passes. Then a critic for the change of season and a fifteenth publish. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last, a fresh reviewer's score against the showcase standard.

Open, below the bar: summer's landing streaks whiter and coarser than approved and its base darker. Summer's pond at rest (item 279). Fall's storm paler than approved. Spring's glass after a shake pale on pale (on main, not live yet). Spring's fence and trails. The fireflies' flat bars at 4K (item 276, a trial). The seeds' lumps of dots at the stills' close camera (item 277). The petals' grain at 4K (item 278, in proof). The frost line at film frame 668 (item 275). The stall at low quality on a software renderer. Winter's four small items. Fall's near fence and the pumpkin's stepped face (item 272). The petals' fringe at film frame 680. The poster tool that stops on one failed request (item 273).
Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger: 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render and no new preview since Preview 07.
